Name: edit of SilentResident's Zelda Items pack
Author: PrinceDarwin
Description:
i made this with hairstyle 44 in mind. but it works with a few other short hair styles. its braindead easy to edit if you want to. all you need to do is take it to any drawing software, draw over the sprites, save, and replace the png file and launch the game.

if you cant do it yourself i may be able to send you a file with an edit for the hair of your choice, but dont count on it

to install just put the unzipped file into the mods folder with smapi


quick edit, for those who dont know the locations the sword is sold by the the adventurers guild, and the hat buy the hat shop

Manifest.Name: (CP)SRZeldaPack
Manifest.Description: Adds Zelda weapons and Kokiri Cap via Content Patcher to Stardew Valley, unofficial port of SilentResident, zcsnightmare, yuikami, and Atomos' JsonAssets version
